text.p: These are the leading stories in the Maltese press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Nationalist Party launches electoral programme. Party determined not to let dockyard problems get out of control.
- First heart transplant at St Luke's hospital.
- Air Malta chairman insists European Union membership is good for airline; membership would enable Air Malta to use Europe's liberalised air transport.
- Young people ready to give Labour election victory.
- Files taken out of Foreign Ministry in secret.
- Prime minister launches electoral programme. Malta has never enjoyed such a high rate of progress, Adami tells election rally.
